task: Parse an AWS S3 bucket name from an S3 URI and extract just the bucket name. Example input: 's3://my-bucket-name/path/to/object.txt'
solution_criteria: Must correctly extract 'my-bucket-name' from various S3 URI formats, handling both virtual-hosted and path-style URIs

task: Create a Python function that takes an AWS IAM policy JSON string and returns a list of all actions (Resource-based or Identity-based) specified in the policy
solution_criteria: Function must parse JSON, handle nested statements, and return a deduplicated list of actions including wildcards like 's3:*'

task: Generate a JSON CloudFormation template snippet that defines an AWS Lambda execution role with basic S3 read permissions
solution_criteria: Must include proper IAM role definition, assume role policy for Lambda service, and an inline policy granting s3:GetObject permissions
